---
name: A project nxwright does not understand
about: nxwright found something it does not know in a project file, and warned about it or refused the file
---

## The report

Run `nxwright report <your project.HMI> report.md`, read `report.md`, and paste it here.

The report leaves out your project's code, texts, names, pictures, fonts, sounds, and password. For each thing nxwright does not know, the report gives at most its first 16 bytes. Those bytes may contain some of your own text, so check them before you paste.

## The Nextion Editor

Which version of the Nextion Editor saved the project? Its Help menu shows the version.

## What you did

What did you do in the Nextion Editor before you saved the project? For example: added a component of a new type, or changed a setting.

## The project file

Could you share the project file privately, if nxwright's maintainers ask? Yes or no.
